ةﻮﻄﺨﺑ ةﻮﻄﺧ ..ﻚﺘﯾاﺮﻗ ﻲﻓPARAGRAPHS · UNIT 1 My Dream Holiday
Since my childhood, I've been dreaming of travelling by ship in the company of my
friends to a foreign country. I want to enjoy the changing state of the sea and
sunbathing on board the ship. It would be a great pleasure when we stay late at night or
when we get lunch or dinner parties. Moreover, Spain is my best destination, where we
can find special ceremonies like the FIESTA or Bull Dancing. It's a special fun that we
can't find in our country. When we say SPAIN, we imagine the bright colours like red,
yellow, orange and purple, which give exciting moments of joy and pleasure. Besides,
we can fancy eating special meals like PAELLA, which is a very delicious Spanish
speciality, in the Spanish restaurant while listening to the fantastic music and watching
their funny dancing groups. I also want to build some relationships with some Spanish
people, so we can exchange visits, and I'm ready to welcome them at home in my
country and show them some of our interesting culture. I hope that my dream comes
true one day.
